wiki.title: Bob Martinson
wiki.extract: Bob Martinson (born August 19, 1952) is an American politician. He is a member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from the 35th District, serving since 2000. He is a member of the Republican Party. Martinson also served in the House from 1972 to 1997 and as Majority Leader in 1993.
